headline: Body of easybike driver with gouged eyes recovered in Narayanganj
summary: The discovery of the deceased easybike driver, bearing severe injuries, has prompted a police investigation into the circumstances surrounding the incident in Narayanganj.
details: The body of an easybike driver was discovered in Narayanganj, showing signs of extreme violence, including gouged eyes. The gruesome discovery has sent shockwaves through the local community.
Local residents found the deceased and immediately informed the authorities. Police arrived at the scene to recover the body and initiate preliminary investigations into the incident.

Authorities are working to identify the victim and determine the exact cause of death. They are also exploring potential motives and searching for any witnesses who might shed light on this brutal crime.

The incident highlights concerns about safety for public transport drivers in the region. Police have assured the public that a thorough investigation will be conducted to bring the perpetrators to justice.
